title: Post Click Prediction
prompt:
A feed team wants to predict whether a user will click a displayed post. Build a baseline and explain how you would evaluate and improve it.

Implement `predict_clicks(train_data, test_data)`. Each record contains numeric `hours_spent_reading_a`, `hours_spent_reading_b`, and `hours_spent_reading_c`, plus `current_post_category` (`A`, `B`, or `C`). Training records also contain the binary label `click`. Assume complete tabular data.
